verdict.rationale: HelixDB docs show a working local self-host quickstart, an embedded-database mode (memory/disk/object storage), and Apache-2.0 open-source licensing, directly supporting self-hosting the core engine. Community skepticism (e.g., asking whether the public repo is 'just a client') raises an open question but is not a confirmed hands-on failure, so it tempers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that a self-hosted instance matches Helix Cloud's full feature set, and clarification of the 'is the core engine actually in the repo' community question.
